hook: Your robot built for 90 days lasted about 15 years.
title: Your 90-day robot lasted 15 years on Mars
description:
NASA's Opportunity rover was built for a 90-day mission on Mars. It landed in 2004 and kept going until 2018, helped along by wind gusts that cleaned its solar panels.

Series: If You Were in Space.
comment_prompt: Would you trust a robot this long? Yes or no
